english.title: Fail to wear a reasonably visible pass at all times when within a restricted area of Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of Gatwick Airport Limited having first been obtained or lawful authority or excuse, when not a bona fide airline passenger and whilst in a restricted area within Gatwick Airport - London, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), failed to wear a pass issued to you by or on behalf of the company so that it was reasonably visible at all times
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 4(17) and 2(1) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
